en.text:
Finishing a reload within 5.3 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for #e${7+#d} seconds.

While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit consumes the buff and applies <arc/>Jolt to the target.

Applied <arc/>Jolt's damage (generally) does not count as Weapon Damage.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff can be held 1 second longer.
